nodes.label: Intelligent Cache Strategy
nodes.rationale: TTL varies by data type: lives=15s (near real-time), poule=15s, bilan=30s, calendrier=30s, detail/club=86400s (24h), search=3600s. This balances fresh scores vs not overloading FFBB official API. Dynamic TTL adaptation based on calendar (Wednesday/weekend live).

nodes.label: FFBB MCP 12-Tool Suite
nodes.rationale: Four generalist tools (ffbb_search, ffbb_get, ffbb_club, ffbb_bilan) cover frequent workflows; specialized tools reduce calls for short questions. 12 read-only tools total to keep surface simple for LLMs while avoiding an overly complex single tool.

nodes.label: Team Resolution Workflow Rules
nodes.rationale: 10 rules (0-9) define deterministic team resolution: score live first, club resolution, single vs multi-engagement handling, engagement filtering (exclude cups/friendlies), scoring by phase+level, fallback with force_refresh, and final season-end messaging.
